title: TimeBlind: A Spatio-Temporal Compositionality Benchmark for Video LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2602.00288v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding is essential for video reasoning and embodied AI. Yet, while Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) master static semantics, their grasp of temporal dynamics remains brittle. We present TimeBlind, a diagnostic benchmark for compositional spatio-temporal understanding. Inspired by cognitive science, TimeBlind categorizes fine-grained temporal understanding into three levels: recognizing atomic events, characterizing event properties, and reasoning about event interdependencies. Unlike benchmarks that conflate recognition with temporal reasoning, TimeBlind leverages a minimal-pairs paradigm: video pairs share identical static visual content but differ solely in temporal structure, utilizing complementary questions to neutralize language priors. translated_title: TimeBlind：面向视频大语言模型的时空组合性基准测试
translated_abstract: 细粒度的时空理解对于视频推理和具身智能至关重要。然而，尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已经掌握了静态语义，它们对时间动态的把握仍然脆弱。我们提出了TimeBlind，一个用于组合性时空理解的诊断基准。受认知科学启发，TimeBlind将细粒度时间理解分为三个层次：识别原子事件、表征事件属性以及推理事件间的相互依赖关系。与那些将识别与时间推理混为一谈的基准不同，TimeBlind采用了最小对范式：视频对共享完全相同的静态视觉内容，但仅在时间结构上存在差异，并利用互补问题来中和语言先验。对20多个最先进的多模态大语言模型（如GPT-5、Gemini 3 Pro）在600个精选实例（2400个视频-问题对）上的评估表明，……
tldr: TimeBlind是一个受认知科学启发的诊断基准，通过最小对范式将细粒度时间理解划分为三个层次，在静态视觉内容完全相同的视频对上测试，揭示了多模态大语言模型虽然精通静态语义，但对时间动态的理解仍然脆弱。
en_tdlr: TimeBlind is a cognitive-science-inspired diagnostic benchmark that decomposes fine-grained temporal understanding into three levels and employs a minimal-pairs paradigm—video pairs with identical static content but different temporal structures—to reveal that MLLMs' grasp of temporal dynamics remains brittle despite their mastery of static semantics.
